runtimeRule: C++ contains BindWidget references, business callbacks, MVVM lifetime and CommonUI routing. Every visual tree is authored in these real WidgetBlueprint Designer assets. No runtime ConstructWidget layout.

assets.name: WBP_MMOLayout
assets.layout: Overlay root with Game/Menu/Modal stacks added in that order, all Fill horizontal/vertical

assets.name: WBP_Login
assets.layout: Centered opaque navy panel; persistent account/password/name labels; two visibly separated sections Account and Character selection; password masked, min12 label, controls readable dark text/light inputs

assets.name: WBP_ManaStatus
assets.layout: VerticalBox, label18pt then progress bar height14

assets.name: WBP_PlayerHUD
assets.layout: Top-left opaque navy player panel, nested actual WBP_ManaStatus; target block; action/menu controls; FieldNotify InputHintText changes with keyboard/gamepad input type. A 1920x1080 viewport is the baseline.
assets.focusPolicy: All five HUD Buttons have IsFocusable=false. Native HUD selects Game input with no desired focus target and no automatic focus restoration, while retaining activation support for the input router. I/View opens inventory; P/Menu opens settings; Escape/B returns from menus. Login and menu Buttons remain focusable.

assets.name: WBP_Inventory
assets.layout: Centered opaque panel with title, inventory list text, use potion and return

assets.name: WBP_Settings
assets.layout: Centered opaque panel with title, explanation; Low/Medium/High, logout and return; Medium is default

assets.name: WBP_Confirm
assets.layout: Centered opaque modal panel, heading and save-on-disconnect explanation, confirm logout and continue buttons

nativeRouting: MMORootLayout owns configurable EditDefaultsOnly TSoftClassPtr fields LoginClass/HUDClass/InventoryClass/SettingsClass/ConfirmClass, default paths to listed assets. ShowInventory/ShowSettings/ShowConfirm resolve and push those classes.
notes: All named widgets must have IsVariable=true and exact case for BindWidget.
Do not set Button OnClicked graph callbacks; native parent binds business callbacks in NativeConstruct and removes in NativeDestruct.
Parent MMO Panel optional Message supports runtime backend feedback. Static titles/captions/style live only in Designer.
Builder must create ManaStatus before HUD so nested Widget class is available; build root and all panels before setting Policy LayoutClass.
MVVM bindings are actual UMVVMBlueprintView configuration compiled with the WBP, not event-graph text.

localization.staticText: FText referencing the original /Game/Localization/ST_MMO StringTable and stable MMOUI namespace/key
localization.dynamicText: FText::Format; character/account names remain culture invariant
